messages.content: Write a descriptive, fictional, imaginative screenplay of a fish being pulled out of the water by a human and made to stare at the solar eclipse. Copy the span of words that lies between (and including) index 5 and 15, the indices are word indices, split by whitespace!

message.content:
FADE IN:

EXT. LAKE SERENE - LATE AFTERNOON

The sky brims with an unnatural amber glow. A man stands at the water's edge, his rod bent like a question mark, the line singing beneath the surface. He pulls. The fish thrashes into air, silver scales catching the dimming light.

The man holds the fish aloft. The fish gapes, its eye wide and ancient, staring upward. Above them, the moon slides across the sun like a slow, dark eclipse creeping across the face of the world. The fish does not blink. It cannot blink. It watches the light die.

The man whispers something. The fish whispers nothing back. The eclipse swallows the sky whole.

FADE OUT.

---
